passages.note: Debate words that encampments will be cleared and the law enforced show the enforcement side but name no penalty type, warnings, or shelter condition, so they do not separate rungs 4 and 5.

rows.reasoning: In the 2026-09-30 debate he said "we will make sure the encampments are cleared we will make sure that we are enforcing the law", which places him on the enforcement side but names no penalty, warnings, or shelter condition, so it cannot choose between "Prohibiting encampments on public property, enforced through graduated warnings and civil penalties" and "Banning public camping and sleeping with criminal penalties". His other passages address services, prevention and funding accountability, which are adjacent to this ladder.
